summary: Builds a 4x4 identity matrix in eight qword slots of a1 with 3DNow! intrinsics: slots 0 and 5 hold the 1.0f constant, slots 2 and 7 hold a punpck-reshuffled pair of 1.0f values, and slots 1, 3, 4, 6 are zeroed, placing ones on the diagonal and zeroes off it.

local_names.a1: output identity matrix base, eight __m64 qword slots
local_names.v3: qword built from two 1.0f words via punpck reshuffle

operations.description: Load the 1.0f constant as a 32-bit MMX value
Store the 1.0f value into slot 0 at offset 0
Build a qword containing two 1.0f words by punpck-reshuffling the loaded value
Store the reshuffled qword into slot 2 at offset 16
Store the 1.0f value into slot 5 at offset 40
Store the reshuffled qword into slot 7 at offset 56
Emit 3DNow! femms to flush the MMX state
Return the output identity matrix base a1
